name: Rotary Phone
summary: Classic dial telephone with the handset resting on its cradles; use for old-fashioned, retro or landline scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the base rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the phone is hero size (about 500 px wide); use about 0.4 on a desk next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: ring = handset shakes with motion lines
